items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a pair on a proper flat morphism of finite presentation is a relative dualizing complex as soon as its restriction to an affine etale covering of the base is isomorphic to the standard pair (statement lines 2140-2157). The proof (proof lines 2158-2226) reduces to an affine base and a single covering morphism, constructs the comparison isomorphism over the covering, verifies agreement on the double cover by uniqueness, and descends using the vanishing of negative self extensions. H3: a multi stage descent argument written out in full.
